Own uncalibrated network model, not observed betting odds: no money line, no aggregated reference and no complete official rating row existed for this fixture. Both ratings come from a Bradley–Terry fit over 4647 finished bo3.gg series, anchored on Valve's official points for 269 teams; the rating-difference one-sigma interval is 129.8 points (probability interval 0.056-0.540). Current lineups, stand-ins and map vetoes are unverified. Low confidence: the interval crosses 50% or a side has fewer than ten finished series. Treat the direction as indicative only.
